description: If the universal test accepts a quantifier-free formula, that exact formula is true at every assignment in every structure, in every model universe.
signature:

  (A : L.Formula α) (hA : FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsQF A)
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.universalTest A = true) (M : Type w) [L.Structure M]
  (a : α → M) : A.Realize a
